questions.question: Dhruv starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards East. He then takes a right turn, drives 11 km, turns right and drives 21 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 11 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.solution:
Let's trace Dhruv's movements:

Starts at Point A, drives 6 km East. (Current position: 6 km East of A)

Takes a right turn (South), drives 11 km. (Current position: 6 km East, 11 km South of A)

Turns right (West), drives 21 km. (Current position: 6 - 21 = -15 km East (i.e., 15 km West), 11 km South of A)

Takes a right turn (North), drives 11 km. (Current position: 15 km West, 11 - 11 = 0 km South/North of A)

Takes a final right turn (East), drives 5 km and stops at Point P. (Current position: 15 - 5 = 10 km West, 0 km North/South of A)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3731f1ae563b06943ee8fe7dad7781d0314490a65a93fcd07c92625b055bec36.png] 

So, Point P is 10 km West of Point A.

To reach Point A again from Point P, Dhruv needs to drive:

 
• Distance: 10 km
 
• Direction: East

He should drive 10 km towards East to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
